column4: dialect-gated: engine/testutil's TestSeedRunNeverShowsAHalfWrittenRun (cleat#3733) calls testutil.TestDB(t, testutil.DialectPostgres) directly, with no per-dialect subtest, and this job supplies SQL Server only, so it skips once under its bare name. It needs PostgreSQL because it guards SeedRun's three-row layout, which exists only there. Measured on the Test SQL Server job of PR #3742: 'multi-db/mssql' had 1 skip(s) matching no ledger line, and this was the test.

same test, same reason as the multi-db/mssql line above: this job supplies MySQL only, so the PostgreSQL gate skips it once under its bare name (cleat#3733). Measured on the Test MySQL job of PR #3742.
